product_method: Direct Blender Cycles renders of the V68 meshes. No image-generated bottle geometry is used in the website.
physical_geometry: 73 mm body; 249.1 mm closed envelope including handle
13 mm round button; 2.2 mm surrounding wall and safety loop section
Compact rear hinge and actual 220 degree open pose
accessory: The existing approved long detachable strap concept is a separate WEB-prefixed rendering accessory, attached at the native body recesses. It adds no collar lugs and changes no source bottle mesh. No accessory dimensions are published.
anatomy: A plane-cut copy of the native body, foot and body O-ring; exact lid meshes translated 24 mm for the illustrative exploded view. Water's lower profile is derived from actual inner-body mesh sections. No screw threads or other construction absent from the source are generated. Internal spray pickup lies entirely in the removed positive-X half and is hidden only in the cutaway; leaving it visible created a misleading vertical steel line through the water.
spray_press: Existing illustrative website gesture: the same native spray mesh is translated 2 mm for the pressed still. This does not add or validate a manufacturing mechanism.

background.method: Built-in image_gen local clean plate, used only through a maintained SVG repair mask. The original scene supplies all remaining background pixels; the native product is composited separately in Blender. Independent original high-resolution character/window/background layers remain registered.
background.prompt: Precise background clean plate for native Blender product compositing. Remove ONLY the giant central bottle, its ENTIRE long ivory strap/metal clips, and the mist plume from this scene. Reveal believable continuation of existing green/gold wall, red leather bench and red/white marble floor behind these removed items. No replacement bottle or other objects. Preserve original camera1536x1024 and every person, face, hand, clothing, pose, furniture, painting, lamp, clock, station architecture and floor outside the removed product/mist region pixel-for-pixel. Do not sharpen, blur, re-style or regenerate people. Independent approved high-resolution character and ticket-window layers will remain in the website. Output1536x1024 lossless PNG.

branding: Existing self-contained exact SVG crests, both supporters, strap animals and braille remain separate. Only the two macro strap tabs are unprinted.
delivery: Versioned lossless PNG masters, lossless WebP deliveries and source-hash-checked responsive variants.

strap_hook.type: Round opening jaw, flat tapered trigger body, small lever/rivet, short swivel and separate rounded D-ring
strap_hook.rejected: Oval wire-loop clip shown in the first native draft; first trigger draft intersecting the body and placing lever above it
strap_hook.scope: All 29 editions, main scene, macro states and cutaway; body geometry and recessed attachment locations unchanged
strap_hook.fit: Round jaw wraps native recessed bridge; curved lever below tapered body. 16 evaluated watertight metal parts, zero body intersection, minimum depicted clearance 0.305 mm. No source mesh change.

main_scene_quality.background: Original background scaled 3x for composition; original independent detail layers retained. No claimed new background detail.
